title: Lent records and Ike Robinson's own record dates
summary: Levy lent old records to a collector and has lost track of him. They compare Ike's recordings with the Bull Fiddle Band.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you know Feather and Gill was here? Yes. Yes. I gave Feather and Gill 30 records, old records, Joe Olive and all the old records. And he was supposed to give them back to me. He was gonna record and do something and give them back to me and I've lost track of the man. He's in New York.
Somebody said he was in San Diego. Well, he's traveling around a little and he's in artwork now.
It's not working. I gotta try to contact him and tell him about that even though it's awful late.
Yeah, but those are collector items. You can't get them records now.
No, I know they're the collector's items. Well, I didn't realize it at the time. Well, you've got a tape machine, have you? I've got a tape machine.

Well, Ike knows. I know most of the fellows around have them. So, ultimately, we'll get them together for you. You just keep in mind what it is you're after and we'll get them for you. I'll take both of them. Oh, you can dig up stuff, man. You don't know about it. There's one of Ike's that I haven't been able to get yet, but we'll get it one of these days.
Ike, didn't I find your four reasons and bring it to you? Yeah.
Yeah, on the first cut. Frankie Jackson. No, no. That's the late cut you got. Oh, is that so? Yeah, that's the last cut I made. Oh, yes.

Well, whatever it is, I put it on my tape and then I brought you the record again. I brought it on tape. Yeah, I brought it on tape. Because I wonder if there was something you did on the banjo there on the grab. Yeah, that was made by… And on the other side, it was two, three records. Bill Johnson, bass.
Yeah, bass, yeah. Called Ake Robertson's Bull Fiddle Band. Yeah. And Count Turner on the banjo. Yeah, yeah. And I was playing banjo and Bobby Warren fiddle.
